definitions.explanation: The half of the Earth that lies north of the equator. Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{北半球|きたはんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan is in the Northern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: {北半球|きたはんきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{六月|ろくがつ}→六月：00662_rokugatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夏至|げし}→夏至：19819_geshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the Northern Hemisphere, the summer solstice falls in June.

examples.japanese: {北半球|きたはんきゅう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{南半球|みなみはんきゅう}→南半球：19054_minamihankyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The seasons are reversed between the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧ (north) + {半球|はんきゅう} (hemisphere). A basic geography term frequently encountered in weather reports, science classes, and travel contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北半球|きたはんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧: countries in the Northern Hemisphere
- {北半球|きたはんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧: Northern Hemisphere climate
- {北半球|きたはんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧: to be located in the Northern Hemisphere

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{南半球|みなみはんきゅう}→南半球：19054_minamihankyuu⟧: Southern Hemisphere
- {東半球|ひがしはんきゅう}: Eastern Hemisphere
- {西半球|にしはんきゅう}: Western Hemisphere
- ⟦{赤道|せきどう}→赤道：04358_sekidou⟧: equator
